title: docs(seed-data): a reference into a tenantField-walled object resolves to the load organization's row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WLWfdqSAaFLKQRS27UZeAT)_

Fixes #33794
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`seed-data.mdx` 里“按组织加载种子时引用解析到哪一行”表格中的一行。以 `tenancy.tenantField` 隔离、没有 `organization_id` 列的对象，现在写的是“只解析到本次加载所属组织的那一行，按该租户列匹配，绝不借用别的组织同名行”。
- 为什么改：该行还停在 #33393 修复之前，写的是“查询被拒并报告”。修复后种子探针按目标对象解析出的租户列过滤，QA 实测也是各组织各自解析到自己的行。文档与行为不符，会误导写种子的人。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档一行，不改代码，不发包（skip-changeset）。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看：`content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` 第 476 行附近的表格行。
- 两分钟验证：`grep -n "tenancy.tenantField" content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`，应看到新句子，且全仓 `content/docs` 与 `skills/` 再搜不到 “refused and reported” 描述这个场景。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One row of the "References on an organization's own load" table in `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`.

- Before: an object walled by another tenant column (`tenancy.tenantField`) with no `organization_id` column resolves "nothing on such a load: the lookup is refused and reported, never answered from another organization".
- After: "a row of the load's organization only, matched on that tenant column (the column a seeded row of such an object is stamped with); another organization's row with the same key is never used".

The row was written for the first org-scoped reference change and went stale with the seed-probe tenant-column fix (PRs #33409 / #33550). Main's probe, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` at `63db7240`:

```ts
// probeScopeOf(targetObject)
const tenantColumn = resolveTenantFieldName(definition) ?? DEFAULT_TENANT_FIELD;
let scope: ProbeScope = { kind: 'organization', tenantColumn };
// ...
// the probe itself
if (scope.kind === 'organization') where[scope.tenantColumn] = organizationId;
```

An object that declares a `tenantField` and no `organization_id` is neither `sys_user`, `sys_organization` nor a global object (`isGlobalSeedObject` needs no tenant field at all), so it keeps the `organization` scope and is probed on its declared column. The integration test `packages/runtime/src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts` pins it: "an object walled by another tenant column resolves within the load organization, on that column" (North gets `tag_gold_n`, South gets `tag_gold_s`, no refusal logged) and "is not taken for a global one: another organization's row is not borrowed". The stamp half ("the column a seeded row of such an object is stamped with") is the shipped 18.5.0 note `1e889b1` in `packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md` and the test block "a dataset OF an object walled by a declared tenant column replays per organization on that column".

## Tests

No code changed; no test edits.

## Acceptance notes

- Changesets: `.changeset/33207-seed-org-scoped-references.md` and `.changeset/33393-seed-probe-tenant-column.md` were both consumed by the Version Packages commit `b914e724` (#33097, 18.5.0). Per the order, nothing is touched. The published `packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md` 18.5.0 section still carries the 33207 bullet saying a `tenancy.tenantField`-walled target "keep[s] the old lookup, and its refusal is now reported" (line 527), which the 33393 note in the same section (line 568) supersedes. AGENTS.md routes a factual error in a released entry to a dedicated docs-only PR amending that entry; that is for the seat to decide (`carrier: seat`). The curated release page `content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx` does not mention this case, so it has nothing to correct.
- Sweep: `grep -rn -i "refused and reported"` over `content/docs` and `skills` at `63db7240` hit only this row; `grep -rn tenantField` over both trees found no other sentence on the seed-reference case. No `skills/**` hit.
